QuestInfo.name: The Cracked Black Crystal
QuestInfo.1: I found Spiruna's #bBlack Crystal#k underneath a rock at the snowfield, but it has some serious cracks on it. Anyway I should give this back to Spiruna immediately.
QuestInfo.2: Spiruna doesn't look so happy after receiving the smashed Black Crystal. She's been like this since it was found...is she angry?\n
QuestInfo.summary: I should go back to Spiruna in Orbis.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 14,680\nCan proceed to the 'Restoring the Crystal' quest\n

0.0: Amidst the pile of snow-covered rocks I see a something shining. Will you stretch your hand out and grab that object?

yes.0: The object found in there was indeed the one Spiruna lost, the #b#t4031050##k

npc.0: There's a little bit of space at the bottom of a rock. Looked carefully inside but found nothing.

item.0: You haven't found my crystal yet. A few days ago I went to the snowfield looking for some materials for this spell I'm currently working on, and wound up losing my precious #bBlack Crystal#k. If you find that crystal, then I'll tell you everything I know of. Good luck.

lost.0: Would you like to reach out and get the object?

yes.0: Inside the rock was the #b#t4031050##k that Spiruna lost.
